description: Java class 'Langchain4jJsonSchemaAdapter' that converts Jackson JSON Schema objects into Langchain4j JsonSchema models.

classes.name: Langchain4jJsonSchemaAdapter
classes.description: Utility class for converting Jackson ObjectNode JSON Schemas into Langchain4j JsonSchema models.

methods.name: fromObjectNode
methods.description: Creates a JsonSchema from a root ObjectNode representing a JSON Schema.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JsonNode into a specific JsonSchemaElement based on its type and properties.

methods.name: parseEnum
methods.description: Builds a JsonEnumSchema from a JsonNode containing an 'enum' array.

methods.name: parseObject
methods.description: Builds a JsonObjectSchema from a JsonNode representing an object schema, including properties and required fields.

methods.name: parseArray
methods.description: Builds a JsonArraySchema from a JsonNode representing an array schema.
